reported_claims.text: Two Libyan military officials said the strike severely damaged the corvette Merkury and set a fire at the base.
A cargo ship was also hit by a sea drone in a second attack hours later.
President Zelenskyy said Ukrainian sea drones sank the Russian warship.

unknowns: Whether the corvette sank or was damaged
reassessment_triggers: Independent imagery confirming the ship's status

update_history.summary: Draft prepared for editorial review (sources accessed 23 November 2026).

title: Suspected Ukrainian sea-drone strike damages Russian corvette at Benghazi naval base
summary: On 22 November 2026 the Russian navy corvette Merkury, docked at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya, was hit by what Libyan officials described as a Ukrainian sea drone; a cargo ship was hit in a second attack hours later. Two Libyan military officials told the Associated Press the corvette was severely damaged and a fire broke out. President Zelenskyy hailed the attack and claimed the ship was sunk. The incident extends the Russia–Ukraine war into North Africa.
impact_assessment: Observed: damage to a Russian warship and a fire at a naval base in a third country. Potential: further attacks on Russian assets in the Mediterranean and Libya, risk to Libyan port operations and shipping, and friction with eastern Libyan authorities.
priority_rationale: HIGH: a significant geographic extension of an interstate war onto a third country's territory. Evidence is Reported because all accounts trace to one wire chain (AP) and Ukraine's claim of a sinking conflicts with Libyan officials' account.
monitoring_actions: Watch for Russian and Libyan National Army statements
Track further incidents at Libyan ports
